name: spellkave_export_grants
label: Export grants
description: Return an artifact of authorized world-owned runtime bindings with source world instance, tick, endpoint, original expiry, digest and complete or scoped coverage. Only a complete publisher export is a reset backup. Optional out uses a host filesystem; hosted delivery returns the artifact.

argumentGates: Actual role, old/new binding coverage, batch bounds and destination-instance guards are checked by D-6 on the server.
